description: This file defines a custom ViewModifier for stylizing views with a glass-like card appearance, including padding, background styling, overlay strokes, and shadow. It also provides an extension on View to easily apply this modifier.

classes.name: StatusGlassCardModifier
classes.description: A ViewModifier that applies a glass card style with configurable brightness and padding.

methods.name: body(content:)
methods.description: Constructs the stylized view with padding, background, overlay stroke, and shadow.

methods.name: statusGlassCard(brighten:verticalPadding:horizontalPadding:)
methods.description: Extension method on View to apply the StatusGlassCardModifier with specified parameters.
